More than a holding company

The right specialist.
One shared standard.

P5 Home Co is the operating family behind four focused home-service companies. It is not a directory or referral network.

Each company has its own craft, team, and expertise. What connects them is the way the work is handled: clear scopes, accountable communication, local knowledge, and respect for the home.

You get a specialist for the project in front of you, with an established family of companies ready for whatever your home needs next.

The P5 family

Four disciplines.
One complete home company.

Choose the team built around your scope. If a project crosses specialties, the companies can coordinate the handoff without leaving you to assemble the pieces.

What P5 adds

Four companies should feel like one good experience.

Specialization should create confidence, not more coordination. These are the operating expectations that connect every P5 company.

01

Clarity before commitment

Planning guidance and written scope details help you understand the work before it begins.

02

One accountable team

You know who owns the next step, who to contact, and where the project stands.

03

Proactive communication

Decisions, schedule changes, and budget impacts are raised early and documented clearly.

04

A connected handoff

When another specialty is needed, P5 can route the project to the right team without sending you back to square one.

Built into the process
  • Written scopes
  • Permits handled in-house where required
  • Dedicated project ownership
  • Workmanship support
